# executes step

Relates an [`Execution`](../classes/gmeow-Execution.md) to the specific [`ProcedureStep`](../classes/gmeow-ProcedureStep.md) it enacts. Non-functional: an execution may enact multiple steps (a batch run), and competing enactment claims coexist.
